steps.what: Check penetration test evidence and record finding facts
Write finding narrative and evidence references

loop.check: Compare each assertion, limitation and evidence reference against checked notes; preserve uncertainty
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; write manually if facts are missing or meaning changes
loop.why_not_simpler: Finding narratives vary and cannot all be filled from fixed phrases

tasks.design: The tester checks and captures finding facts in {DOCS}, then a bounded drafting step turns those notes into a narrative. The tester verifies claims and evidence before recording the exact final finding in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence is scattered across notes and test outputs, while each finding needs a different explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded writing step can use selected notes without deciding whether a weakness is real.
tasks.still_hard: Proving impact, distinguishing observation from inference and protecting sensitive evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The tester decides what the evidence establishes and what remains uncertain.
tasks.altitude: A little less prose composition; the tester retains finding ownership.

reach.task: Turn verified findings into remediation acceptance criteria
reach.learn: Operational constraints and measurable closure criteria

evidence.claim: Drafting narrative from checked evidence is plausible, but the proposed time reduction is unmeasured.
XBOW reports include resolved, duplicate and informative outcomes; report volume alone does not establish finding quality or labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is documenting individual findings after testing, excluding test execution and the consolidated audit report.

The tester produces checked finding notes in s1: finding identifier, affected asset, observation, evidence reference, test conditions, demonstrated impact, limitations and chosen severity rationale. All selection, transcription and redaction time remains in s1; missing fields require manual clarification before drafting.
Try native document templates and existing finding records before adding a model step; existing export runtime earns no saving.
Individual finding documentation is owned here once; audit report composition must not count it again.
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce total writing plus review time without unsupported impact claims?

already_counted.description: Evidence capture and final finding verification remain in s1 and s3

incremental.description: Maintain examples, test drafts and inspect evidence access settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact finding record text, evidence links, severity rationale and destination version; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gives gross14 and net9 after5 upkeep. A 0-5% range allows sensitive findings to require substantial rewriting; no test execution saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify security weaknesses through authorised tests

steps.what: Choose penetration tests within the authorised assessment scope
Perform scoped tests and evaluate security weaknesses

tasks.design: The tester selects and conducts scoped tests using the assessment tools in {OTHER}. Existing automated checks support the work, while contextual investigation and weakness assessment stay with the tester.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical access alone does not explain exploitability or business impact.
tasks.enabler_now: Scanning and assisted testing are available, but this task has no demonstrated incremental labour reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting ambiguous results and keeping tests within approved operational limits.
tasks.human_edge: The tester links observations to credible weaknesses and decides when investigation should stop.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in test ownership or decision rights.

reach.task: Preserve assessment evidence for later investigation

evidence.claim: Aikido Security offers code, dependency and cloud scanning and AI pentesting; that availability does not prove safe autonomous coverage of this task.

assumptions: Boundary is authorised test selection, execution and interpretation, excluding authorisation negotiation and finding report writing.

OTHER means the existing security assessment toolset. The assessment owner provides the written scope, assets, allowed methods, timing and stop contacts before s1; the tester reads and clarifies these in s1. No new structured interface or automatic action is proposed.
Existing tool runtime is not human effort. Test native capabilities before considering a separate build.
Zero incremental upkeep because the proposal preserves the existing workflow and adds no new component.
research_questions: Which repeatable test activities consume human time after current native automation is used?

incremental.description: No added component or ongoing work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net0. Existing automated scanning is already part of the baseline and earns no new labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write audit reports and recommended solutions

steps.what: Interpret findings and choose report recommendations
Write audit report from checked findings and recommendations

loop.purpose: Compose the consolidated report without inventing conclusions
loop.input: outline, checked findings and tester-selected recommendations
loop.output: audit report draft with source references
loop.check: Trace every conclusion and recommendation to the supplied findings and selected rationale; check audience meaning and caveats
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; tester writes unclear sections manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Executive explanations and procedural context vary beyond a fixed template

steps.what: Verify final audit report and communicate approved conclusions

tasks.design: The tester selects conclusions and solutions in {DOCS}, using verified findings from {PROJECT}. A bounded writing step drafts the report, then the tester checks the final meaning and communicates the approved version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report writing combines repetitive prose with recommendations that need situational judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: A drafting step can express chosen conclusions while preserving links to the supporting findings.
tasks.still_hard: Prioritising remedies, communicating uncertainty and avoiding claims beyond assessment scope.
tasks.human_edge: The tester decides which remedies are justified and explains tradeoffs to the assessment owner.
tasks.altitude: The tester spends slightly less time assembling prose and retains responsibility for every recommendation.

reach.task: Explain remediation acceptance criteria to system owners

evidence.claim: Constrained drafting from checked findings and human-selected recommendations is plausible; the task-specific time estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is consolidated audit report interpretation, writing and communication. Individual finding creation is owned by the finding-documentation task and is not saved twice.

The tester produces the outline and recommendation notes in s1, including report audience, scope, finding references, priorities, chosen remedies, rationale and limitations. Reading, selection and capture remain fully counted. Missing findings are returned for clarification rather than invented.
The finding-documentation task produces verified finding records before s1; this is existing work, not a new unpaid transfer.
Try native report templates and finding exports before custom integration or a model step.
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total report time after recommendation checks and final communication are included?

already_counted.description: Human interpretation, recommendation selection and final report verification

incremental.description: Maintain report examples and check sampled outputs

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report, attachments, source references, recommendations and recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gives gross14, net9 after5 upkeep. Range0-5% covers reports needing extensive redrafting for sensitive or contested findings; no recommendation judgement saving.

steps.what: Select cyber intelligence sources and capture search criteria
Collect vulnerability notices and remove exact duplicates
Read cyber intelligence and judge vulnerability relevance

tasks.design: Configure the existing intelligence reader in {OTHER} to collect selected sources and remove exact duplicate notices. The tester retains source selection, reading and relevance decisions, recording conclusions in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly checking selected sources consumes time before analysis begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Native subscriptions and identifier-based deduplication can consolidate notices without interpreting vulnerability applicability.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing provenance, relevance, affected versions and conflicting intelligence.
tasks.human_edge: The tester distinguishes an interesting notice from a credible issue worth investigating.
tasks.altitude: Less source retrieval; no change to intelligence judgement or testing authority.

evidence.claim: Native feed collection and exact identifier deduplication are plausible; the proposed labour saving depends on current manual retrieval.

assumptions: Boundary is intelligence source selection, collection and interpretation, excluding actual system testing and remediation.

OTHER means the existing vulnerability intelligence reader. The tester produces selected source addresses, product terms, date window and refresh frequency in s1; all selection and capture time is counted there.

Existing intelligence publishers produce notice identifier, source reference, publication time, product text and notice body as part of normal publication before retrieval. The reader preserves source fields and deduplicates only exact source plus identifier; no affected-asset flag is inferred. Missing or malformed fields go to manual retrieval and reading in s3.
Test native subscriptions before custom code. If retrieval is already automatic, claim zero retrieval saving rather than saving runtime.
research_questions: How many human retrieval minutes remain after native subscriptions, including malformed feed handling?

already_counted.description: Source criteria capture, reading, relevance decisions and manual exceptions

incremental.description: Check subscriptions, missing notices and source changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20 and net14 after6 upkeep. Range1-8% assumes some manual collection and allows field failures and existing subscriptions to reduce the gain; already automated retrieval gives no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less evidence prose and repeated notice retrieval, with testing and recommendation judgement retained.
reach: Prepare source-linked remediation acceptance notes for information security engineers
role.ambitious_version: A tester who connects verified evidence to clear, testable remediation decisions.
